classification: Read-only matched-source marginal-benefit audit against saved primary Grok4.3 predictions; not a rerun or new production benchmark.
guardrails: Uses baseline papers[].variants only, not comparison_variants or linkage-assisted rows.
Only positive-valued frozen reference questions are included.
Packet/reference endpoint and scope differences exclude numerical equality or difference from safe comparisons.
Raw or validated Astra success after a failed experimental Grok4.6 request is not automatically a gain over retained Grok4.3 production.

queries.reason: Baseline 185/97/62 includes broader cohort and combined clinical phenotype; packet 179/45/133 requests living baseline people and Previous symptoms only. Numerical differences are not errors or gains.
